about: The screens (each package's show/ folder, with the read-data and do-work files they import) of the retired bitfield-packages repository at d926b7adb, for every package with no copy or successor in the Workshop or the apps repository, move byte for byte into the Workshop tool that owns the job. Packages a rewritten successor already serves, packages with only some files moved, and packages with no owning tool were listed, not moved. Nothing is wired into the app by file path: the tool row's screen module declaration mounts a screen.
